places.name: Arunachaleswarar Temple
places.blurb: A massive, ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located at the base of the holy Annamalai Hills.

places.name: Javadi Hills
places.blurb: An offbeat mountain range offering scenic winding roads, deep valleys, and pristine waterfalls.

places.name: Sathanur Dam
places.blurb: A picturesque dam across the Thenpennai River featuring lush gardens, a crocodile farm, and a suspension bridge.

places.name: Vellore Fort
places.blurb: A 16th-century granite fortress famous for its massive moats, ancient temple, and rich military history.

places.name: Auroville
places.blurb: An experimental experimental township dedicated to human unity and peace, centered around the iconic Matrimandir.

places.name: Yercaud
places.blurb: A charming and peaceful hill station in the Shevaroy Hills known for its cool climate and expansive coffee plantations.

places.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
places.blurb: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring stunning 8th-century rock-cut architecture overlooking the sea.

places.name: Skandashramam
places.blurb: A serene cave dwelling high on the Arunachala hill where Sri Ramana Maharshi lived for several years.
